name: fpv_5in
notes: 5-inch FPV class build from the seed catalogue. The T-Motor T5143S propeller has no UIUC data of its own: its Ct/Cp table is the APC 12x6E table used as a SCALED stand-in (ASSUMED, flagged in the sidecar), and 5 in props spin faster than that table covers, so the propeller runs on the held edge value for most of the envelope.
